answer: A staked identity bond is one concrete anchor against sybil attacks. Each agent must lock forfeitable collateral to join; detected fake identities get slashed and lose it. This ties reputation to real capital, so spinning up a thousand sybils means posting a thousand bonds. The relic of free, costless account creation dies. Identity stops being a cheap opal trinket minted at will and becomes money at risk. An attacker must fund every fake up front, then forfeits the whole stake on slashing, making large sybil fleets far too costly to run.
